ev.q: Six Phase III studies evaluated the safety and immunogenicity of DTaP-IPV-Hib-HepB
The work group evaluated the relevant evidence related to the potential benefits and harms of DTaP-IPV-Hib-HepB.
This report summarizes the indications for DTaP-IPV-Hib-HepB and provides guidance for its use.
Six Phase III studies evaluated the safety and immunogenicity of DTaP-IPV-Hib-HepB
